comparison.objective: Break an over-centre knee brace and fold a radiator panel onto rest pads; candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Applying force at a linkage knee and controlling a folding panel versus tool insertion, bimanual counterholding, collar adjustment, setscrew locking, and cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Panel stowed and released on pads; exact angle, load, damage, and hold thresholds are missing. Candidate has explicit operating-envelope, hard-stop, rebound, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Releasing and folding an over-centre linkage does not test iterative damping adjustment or setting retention.
